hardware.cuda: NVIDIA CUDA not applicable to Apple M1; this does not imply no local runtime.
hardware.mpsRuntime: Hardware/Metal eligible in principle; actual torch.backends.mps.is_available untested because torch absent.

tesseract.capability: Real CPU OCR and word boxes; not terrain/object/pip/card-bonus recognition by itself.

swift.newDependenciesForNativeOCR: SDK framework available candidate, Swift/Vision smoke still required

smallestRealInferenceTest.route: Installed Tesseract CLI CPU OCR, no external service/new dependency/weights
smallestRealInferenceTest.input: Existing exact Catan problem photo from tests; no GT/annotations supplied to recognizer
smallestRealInferenceTest.evaluation: After OCR only, compare digit observations and their source boxes with pre-frozen 18-number GT. Report whole-photo false positives/unknown and missing separately; never count OCR as full Catan recognition.
smallestRealInferenceTest.mustRetain: Original imageSHA/evidence/source crop; null vs0; no owner/slot/accepted inference
smallestRealInferenceTest.expectedPerformance: UNKNOWN; do not invent latency/accuracy thresholds
smallestRealInferenceTest.whyUseful: Tests actual lightweight number extraction with boxes before connecting recognition schema. It does not replace the needed local object/color/shape reader.

nextLearnedCandidate.reason: Primary documented OCR_WITH_REGION + object detection/region proposal tasks, pixel source outputs and CPU fallback; considered for functional fit, not only parameter count. No board-game accuracy guarantee.
nextLearnedCandidate.doNotDownloadBoth: model.safetensors463MB vs duplicate pytorch_model.bin464MB; repo total930MB includes both
nextLearnedCandidate.dependencyDownloadSize: UNKNOWN until versions/platform wheels pinned; no resolver/install invoked
nextLearnedCandidate.macRuntime: CPU float32 path documented; MPS operator compatibility and peak memory/latency UNKNOWN until smoke. No new paid GPU required for the documented CPU attempt.
nextLearnedCandidate.customCode: Official model requires trust_remote_code in example: review/pin custom code before execution; no downloaded repository code was executed.
nextLearnedCandidate.diskFeasibility: About31GiB free now; model footprint fits on disk, runtime peak RAM not proven.

reuse: native Catan/Rummikub normalizers and existing explicit candidate confirmation path
existingIntegrationBoundary.notYetImplemented: No local detector/runtime adapter or edition-matched template index was added. Await Astra common observation contract and supervisor file ownership.
existingIntegrationBoundary.referencePolicy: Display SVGs are usable output art; do not train/template-match representative art as proof of real printed identity. Use actual edition-matched photos only within their verified scope; unknown identity remains null.
